title: MSIT, MS ECE and MS EAI programs
field: Information technology, electrical and computer engineering, engineering artificial intelligence
about: Master's programs at CMU-Africa: MS in Information Technology, MS in Electrical and Computer Engineering and MS in Engineering Artificial Intelligence, for fall 2027. Early deadline December 15; applications officially close January 15.
requirements: Bachelor's degree, or in the final year of a bachelor's program
Online application, written and video essays, CV, three recommenders and unofficial transcripts
DET fees covered for first-time applicants who apply by the December 15 early deadline

upskill.name: AI Foundations
why: "Master of Science in Engineering Artificial Intelligence (MS EAI)" → "Image classification: AlexNet (2012), VGG, ResNet, EfficientNet milestones" (A001.07, Computer Vision I, AI Foundations)
"engineering artificial intelligence" field → "Vision-Language Models (VLMs): CLIP, Flamingo, LLaVA - joint vision-text understanding" (A001.08, Computer Vision II, AI Foundations)
Stated requirements are admission criteria (bachelor's degree, essays, CV, recommenders); no single course objective covers them, so the post links to the closest Academy page rather than a course.

card_alt: Card for MSIT, MS ECE and MS EAI programs at Carnegie Mellon University Africa in Kigali, Rwanda, with applications closing 15 Jan 2027. The generic default photo shows an aerial sunset view of a city skyline with a tall tower beside a river; it is not a Kigali landmark.
